Reporting a Calculation Issue

Four details help us reproduce and fix a problem quickly

Our calculators run entirely in your browser and never send your inputs to a server, so we can only see the numbers you include in your message. Please add:

The page URL — which calculator or guide you were using.
Your exact inputs — amount, pay period, hours per week, paid weeks per year, and any overtime settings.
Result shown vs. expected — the figure displayed and the figure you expected, with how you calculated it.
Device and browser — for display problems, whether you were on mobile or desktop, and which browser.

A Note on Scope

Hourly Wage Converter is an educational tool. We can explain how a calculation works and correct our own content, but we cannot provide personal tax advice, determine your exact withholding, or intervene in a dispute with an employer. For tax filing questions, pay stub discrepancies, or wage-and-hour claims, please consult a certified public accountant, your employer's payroll department, or a licensed employment attorney.
